{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing persistent undershoot of ~0.3-0.6 for first 10-15 days then converging",
    "Bias is most pronounced on early forecast horizons within the 30-day range, with convergence by day 20+",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with forecast corrections - high sentiment (1.00) regions show larger undershoots matching true outcomes better than low sentiment areas",
    "When sentiment shows negative values (-0.33), model forecasts align better with true outcomes, reducing the initial undershoot gap",
    "Mean reversion effect strengthens forecast accuracy from day 10-20 where both model and true outcomes show systematic movement toward historical mean ranges",
    "Sentiment momentum matters - when sentiment has been rising across the history (00, 33, 67, 100 sequence), the forecast lag is more pronounced",
    "No significant correction needed for final 5-10 days of the 30-day forecast as both model and reality converge to stable ranges" ]}
